subject: Private deployment security discovery — next actions

Subject: Follow-up: Security & private deployment options for NovaCare

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Security posture items you flagged: SOC 2 scope, GDPR data residency questions, HIPAA handling for PHI, and vendor questionnaire kickoff.
2) Deployment options to evaluate: VPC with private control plane, on-prem installer, and an air-gapped variant for highly regulated environments.

Action items we committed to:
- Attach a short checklist that maps your questions to our artifact owners (SOC 2 report timeline, encryption/KMS details, retention policy).
- Share a compact VPC/on-prem diagram + an air-gap option.
- Send our vendor security questionnaire template to centralize your questions and track responses.

Can we target Thursday 10/1 for a technical walkthrough with your infra/security team? If that works please share attendee list.

Thanks,
Mina
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: nova_private_deploy_checklist.pdf (application/pdf), vendor_sq_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Julian Cortez <julian.cortez@novacarehealth.com>

Cc: Sarah Park <sarah.park@novacarehealth.com>, security@novacarehealth.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & private deployment options for NovaCare

Mina — appreciate the recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we need Type II evidence for the last 6 months; what cadence can Redwood provide for access to SOC artifacts during procurement?
- GDPR / Data residency: we expect EU customer data to remain in EU regions; how does the private control plane handle metadata vs. customer data?
- HIPAA: we need to confirm that the Private deployment option can be configured inside our VPC without egress to any public endpoints. Is that supported in the air-gapped variant?

We can do the technical walkthrough on 2026-10-01 at 11:00 AM ET — joining from our side will be myself, Sarah Park (security lead), and one of our infra engineers (Tariq Mendes).

Also: please send the VPC diagram and the vendor questionnaire template — we'll populate the questionnaire and return it.

Thanks,
Julian
Director of Infrastructure, NovaCare Health
julian.cortez@novacarehealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Security & private deployment options for NovaCare

Looping in a quick engineering note ahead of the 10/1 call.

- SOC 2: we can provide the latest Type II report under NDA (standard process) and a point-of-contact for ad-hoc evidence requests.
- Metadata vs customer data: in Private deployments, customer data (tokens, payloads) stays in the tenant VPC. The control plane can be customer-managed (no outbound telemetry) if you choose the isolated private control plane option.
- Air-gap: our air-gapped installer supports no external outbound connections; updates are via signed offline bundles and customer-controlled transfer.

I'll attach an updated VPC diagram and short notes about where KMS/HSM integrations sit. Sean, can you confirm IL (ingress/egress) requirements we usually highlight for procurement?

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
